name: interaction-governance
description: Single owner of agent response format: rules F1-F15, injected at SessionStart and checked at Stop. Adopts, adapts or deliberately overrides the ayghri/i-have-adhd ruleset, with the reasoning for each override kept written. Also ships the tooling-catalog skill: the taxonomy of skills, plugins, subagents, commands, MCP servers and hooks, and the procedure to install, verify and remove each.
